data.description: The motorbike, or motorcycle, is a one-seat ride that runs on low grade fuel, with a full tank (500) lasting around 71 minutes. You can't buy one. [Junkyard](/monument/junkyard) has the most with 7 spawns, then [Water Treatment Plant](/monument/water-treatment-plant) with 4 and Airfield with 3, plus one each at spots like [Oxum's Gas Station](/monument/oxums-gas-station), [The Dome](/monument/the-dome) and Train Yard. To repair the bike, hit it with a hammer. A full repair takes 6 swings and up to 50 frags.
